TC-21/S06.title: A hand-picked discharge template is never carried into a fresh pre-selection (both contexts)
TC-21/S06.detail: Local 25acd727, in-app navigation (the app's back control and the switcher, no page load). Hospital and Nursing Home halves (the NH half is new: SNF discharge exists on this build). 12/12 judged: positive controls (Discharge summary / SNF discharge picked by hand shows, 3 times per context); a badge change pre-selects afresh (New Admission -> H&P / SNF admission, never the discharge pick); after a reload the badge's template (SOAP progress / SNF follow-up) is pre-selected; another patient / resident opened right after the pick shows its badge's template, never the discharge template. Q11 recorded (not judged): the physician's own discharge pick is kept when the same chart is reopened in-app the same day and after a Hospital -> Nursing Home -> Hospital round-trip (the pick lives in the page session: src/features/clinical/useNoteFormats.ts 'picks'); the strict reading of S06 wants the badge's template there. Daniela's answer to Q11 decides those two cells.
